name: uk.co.uanalyse/football
title: uanalyse football predictions
description: Model probabilities for football matches: 1X2, goals, corners, season outlooks. Free tier.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Football fixtures on one UTC date with the model's home/draw/away probabilities, kickoff time, status and a match_id. Optionally filter by competition slug (e.g. english-premier-league).

date.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD, within 7 days of today

tools.name: search_matches
tools.description: Find upcoming or recent fixtures by team name (and optionally the opponent), today and the next 7 days unless a date is given. Returns match_ids and home/draw/away probabilities.

date.description: UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD, within 7 days of today

tools.name: get_match_probabilities
tools.description: Pre-match probabilities for one match: home/draw/away, markets (both teams to score, over/under goals, corners and more) and goal-total distributions. Use a match_id from get_fixtures or search_matches.

tools.name: get_season_outlook
tools.description: The model's simulated final-table chances for a league season: for each team, the probability of each finishing position and the expected position. Use a competition slug such as english-premier-league or german-bundesliga.

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Tell uanalyse what football data or predictions you wish this server offered (a market, a league, a stat). Plain text, up to 500 characters. Nothing else is stored.
